_what: Outcome counts for the block-circulant decoder before and after the correctness fix described in docs/benchmark_1D_2D_BC_report.md (the gf_solve fabricated-values fault and the pairwise phase accepting systems it had not solved).
_why_a_file: This is the one figure in docs/ whose numbers are not regenerated by a script in this repo. It measures a historical run at omega=rho=lambda=2, mu=2048 -- a parameterisation the current sweep does not include -- against a version of the decoder that no longer exists. The counts are recorded here, with their provenance, so that the figure is still drawn from data by make_figures.py rather than hand-drawn as inline SVG. Re-measuring 'before' would mean restoring the faulty decoder.
_provenance: Reported in the decoder-fix section of docs/benchmark_1D_2D_BC_report.md. 40 trials, ten each at 5%, 15%, 25% and 45% erasure. Before the fix the decoder claimed success on all 40 and was wrong on 31 of them, so it never once reported a failure; 'honest failure' is therefore zero for that column by construction, not by luck.
